note: Telegram user ids of staff, the only reliable way to tell a host's message from a player's. `isOut` cannot do it: it is relative to the account making the request, so reading as @Thrill_VIP_Ops, a message Colton sent from his own account comes back isOut=false exactly like a player's.
method: Derived from 50 readable player chats sampled across the silence range. A player appears in one chat, a host in dozens, so distinct-chat count separates them cleanly: the top six sit at 19-42 chats and the next sender sits at 2.

staff.name: VIP Ops
staff.note: the reader account, staff by definition regardless of sample count
